explanation: A title for God that points to his dominion and authority over all things.
The planet we live on, which according to the Bible was created by God.
To set up or lay the foundation for something; in this context it refers to God's act of creating the earth.
The vast bodies of water that cover most of the earth's surface.
Natural waterways that flow from a higher level to a lower one, often toward the sea.
A reference to Jacob, one of the patriarchs in the Hebrew tradition and ancestor of Israel's twelve tribes.
Freedom from sin and impurity, both physical and spiritual.
The quality of being just and morally upright; acting in accordance with God's will and commands.
Deliverance from sin and its consequences, obtained through faith in God and his grace.
A title for God that emphasizes his sovereignty and rule over the entire universe.
Respect, admiration, and recognition given to someone because of their status, achievements, or virtues.
